name: awm-monorepo
description: Frontend source for the modular awm tree (lives at awm/package.json). ui_components/* are importable component libraries (just src/ + an index.ts barrel, imported by name as @awm/<name>); pages/* are static bundles (index.html + src/) built to pages/<name>/dist/ and served at /ui/<name>. There are no per-unit package.json/vite.config.ts: one root vite.config.ts resolves @awm/* by path alias and one build loop (scripts/build.sh) builds every page. Third-party deps are declared once here.
